welcome.say: Hi, I'm FocusLens. Four gestures, under a minute. Use back anytime to skip.

pinch.say: Zoned out in a lecture? Pinch, and I'll tell you what you missed. Try it now.

save.say: Swipe right to save this moment for your evening review. Try it.

note.say: A thought distracting you? Swipe down and say it. I'll keep it for later. Try it.

cards.say: Swipe up to see the cards from this session. Try it.

done.say: That's it. Swipe left to go back. Start a session on the Session page, or just say: hey lens. Your notes and cards are on your phone too.
